summary: Model updated for the NEWLEADER/UPTODATE change; three model-checking findings and two code-review findings were reproduced on the updated implementation.
validation_limits: All TLC runs are budget-limited (30 min each); no state space was exhausted. MC.cfg BFS reached depth 28 (16.9M distinct states), Update-full BFS depth 28 (17.5M), focused BFS depth 29, discharge depth 22; simulation follow-ups are recorded in spec/model-checking-campaign.md.

The full-MCNext counterexample for MC-1 starts from seeded epoch-2 states whose reachability is shown by canary NotUpdateDurabilityGap and by replaying the real diff-sync-uncommitted trace; the data-loss consequence (CommittedAgreement) was not reached by model checking within budget and is shown only by the implementation reproduction.
Open-spec (EnvUpdate) results are claimed only for a fixed established epoch; epoch creation is covered only by the full MCNext checks.
The leaked SyncThread of CR-4 is modeled only for its history effect; quiescence guards on ElectLeader and LeaderSyncFollower assume it drains before an election completes.

MC-1 and MC-2 reproductions use Level 1 timing assistance (delayed follower SyncThread plus crash emulation; delayed NEWLEADER-ACK write); MC-3 (deterministic fixture; real cluster triggers in 4 of 5 runs), CR-4 and CR-5 are Level 0.
Builds and tests used JDK 11 (prior run used JDK 21). Observers, dynamic reconfiguration and the pre-Zab1.0 protocol remain outside the model scope.
Novelty was not assessed: issue-tracker and history research is prohibited in this blind run.

findings.title: NEWLEADER quorum commits a DIFF history that acknowledging learners have only enqueued
findings.cause: At NEWLEADER the learner persists currentEpoch and only enqueues the DIFF proposals to the asynchronous SyncRequestProcessor before writing the NEWLEADER ACK that commits the leader's initial history.
findings.trigger: Leader re-elected with an uncommitted logged txn DIFF-syncs both learners; they ACK NEWLEADER and crash before their SyncThread forces the txn; the learners then elect a new leader.
findings.consequence: A transaction the old leader served after the NEWLEADER quorum is missing on the new leader (committed data lost).

premises: FollowerZooKeeperServer.logRequest only enqueues to the SyncRequestProcessor; nothing between logRequest and the NEWLEADER ACK write waits for its flush.
The leader treats the NEWLEADER quorum as the commit of its loaded history and serves it.
FLE ranks peer currentEpoch before zxid, so a learner that persisted the new epoch can win the next election with a shorter log.

findings.title: SyncRequestProcessor ACK written before the NEWLEADER ACK is consumed as the NEWLEADER ACK
findings.cause: The update starts the learner pipeline (startupWithoutServing) before the learner thread writes the NEWLEADER ACK, so a forced proposal's ACK can be the first packet LearnerHandler reads after NEWLEADER.
findings.trigger: DIFF sync with at least one proposal; the learner thread is delayed between logRequest and the NEWLEADER ACK write (GC pause, preemption, or a large DIFF batch).
findings.consequence: Leader.waitForNewLeaderAck discards the ACK as from a different epoch; the re-elected leader fails to establish its epoch and times out, and an established leader loses that proposal ACK.

premises: LearnerHandler treats the first ACK after NEWLEADER as the NEWLEADER ACK and waitForNewLeaderAck ignores a mismatching zxid.
SyncRequestProcessor and the learner thread share the learner output stream.

findings.title: COMMIT received after NEWLEADER for a proposal buffered before it throws NullPointerException
findings.cause: The update clears packetsNotCommitted at NEWLEADER while the unchanged sync-loop COMMIT handler dereferences packetsNotCommitted.peekFirst() without a null check.
findings.trigger: A learner (re)joins an established leader while writes are in flight: outstanding PROPOSALs are forwarded before NEWLEADER and their COMMIT after it.
findings.consequence: NullPointerException in Learner.syncWithLeader aborts synchronization; the learner returns to LOOKING and cannot join under load.

premises: Leader.startForwarding queues outstanding proposals before LearnerHandler queues NEWLEADER, and their COMMITs can follow NEWLEADER.

findings.title: Learner failing between NEWLEADER and UPTODATE leaks its request processors
findings.cause: startupWithoutServing leaves the learner server INITIAL and canShutdown() accepts only RUNNING or ERROR, so Follower.shutdown() after a failure before UPTODATE does not stop the started processors.
findings.trigger: Connection loss, timeout or exception after NEWLEADER and before UPTODATE, followed by the normal Follower.shutdown().
findings.consequence: SyncThread and CommitProcessor threads keep running after shutdown, the data tree is not fast-forwarded, and the orphaned SyncThread keeps writing the shared log and ACKs to a dead connection.

premises: QuorumPeer.run calls follower.shutdown() after every followLeader(); LearnerZooKeeperServer.shutdown returns early when canShutdown() is false.

findings.title: Pre-Zab1.0 synchronization never starts the learner server
findings.cause: The UPTODATE-only (pre-Zab1.0) path now calls zk.startServing() without the startupWithoutServing() that only the NEWLEADER branch performs.
findings.trigger: A leader speaking the pre-Zab1.0 protocol (NEWLEADER in discovery, UPTODATE without NEWLEADER in the sync loop).
findings.consequence: NullPointerException in Learner.syncWithLeader; the learner never reaches a running BROADCAST state.

premises: Only peers speaking the pre-Zab1.0 learner protocol send UPTODATE without NEWLEADER in the sync loop.
